svg.title: Module clusters and corpus pointers
svg.desc: Matrix cells count declared request and return arrows between six ownership clusters. The directory below maps every one of the 22 modules to code, context, completion and public contracts. Forty directional arrows derive from 20 declared semantic flows. They are not build imports, measured runtime calls or new services. Same-cluster flows occupy diagonal cells.
svg.text: CS06 / Module clusters and corpus pointers
CORPUS WORKFLOW · current tooling and future admission are labelled · follow source pointers below
Read row → column. A cell counts mapped arrows; the edge table names each contract.
Blue = declared semantic request. Teal = return. Split cell = both. Blank = no mapped edge.

g.title: E03: F02 task → store: Expected state/generation plus atomic attempt/event changes; E04: F02 store → task: Committed identity or typed conflict/storage failure; E09: F05 task → budget: Attempt/verification reservation and later measured usage; E10: F05 budget → task: Admit/refuse, remaining budget and reconciliation discrepancy; E21: F11 task → recovery: Persisted active attempts and observed process/session identities; E22: F11 recovery → task: Reconciled state, cleanup result or quarantined ambiguity

E05: F03 task → route: Task class, immutable constraints and candidate observations; E07: F04 task → roster: Capability/locality/version/health query whose returned facts are passed to pure route policy; E11: F06 task → worker: Attempt/generation, recipe, owned workspace, limits and cancellation

E15: F08 task → cohort: Parent criteria, child DAG, thread briefs and resource/budget bounds; E19: F10 task → notify: Committed outcome event and relevant recipients; E38: F19 task → workflows: Step results, outstanding obligations, repair/stop and parent evidence

E13: F07 task → check: Acceptance revision, immutable candidate and protected fixture references; E25: F13 task → numerical: Immutable outcome dataset at declared cutoff, including failed/cancelled/abandoned attempts and unknown usage, plus requested comparison
E02: F01 task → herdr: Status, route reason, blocking criterion and completion references
E30: F15 task → actions: Admission/state/evidence or typed denial/conflict

E06: F03 route → task: Eligible recipe, exclusions, evidence freshness and fallback; E08: F04 roster → task: Declared and observed facts with identity and age; E12: F06 worker → task: Ack/activity, usage, candidate references, exit/error and settled state
E27: F14 roster → service: Explicit discovery, cached-state query or specifically approved bounded probe; lifecycle mutation uses F20

E16: F08 cohort → task: Child candidates, dissent, integration gaps and join readiness; E20: F10 notify → task: Delivery receipt or pending/retryable notification state; E37: F19 workflows → task: Versioned finite action composition and expanded child identity, mediated by actions/app with current authority

E17: F09 cohort → context: Current brief revision, role, permitted sources and context limit; E18: F09 context → cohort: Selected context/artifact pointers, separate source and task-relationship coverage gaps, whole-workflow context cost and provenance; E35: F18 skills → context: Selected skill/version, action compatibility and bounded references; E36: F18 context → skills: Task-scoped instructions, source and relationship provenance, explicit omissions and context preparation cost
E14: F07 check → task: Criterion observations, checker errors and raw evidence references; E26: F13 numerical → task: Validated quantitative report and candidate-policy disposition
E23: F12 numerical → julia: Immutable dataset, schema/units, analysis recipe and resource bound; E24: F12 julia → numerical: Report/policy candidate, dataset identity, uncertainty and error
E01: F01 herdr → task: Versioned intent and operator constraints enter actions/app; authenticated task-scoped request reaches task
E28: F14 service → roster: Timestamped useful-health and actual owner/state observation
E40: F20 service → actions: Lifecycle owner/job identity, observed result/useful health or unknown effect
E29: F15 actions → task: Schema-validated, caller-bound task request and idempotency context
E39: F20 actions → service: Caller-bound explicit grant, registered service/unit/action and durable operation key

E31: F16 bash → actions: Typed argv/JSON and caller task context; E32: F16 actions → bash: Structured result, decisive exit status and evidence references; E33: F17 pi_extension → actions: Registered tool call, cancellation signal and admitted versions; E34: F17 actions → pi_extension: Typed result/error, usage, effective identity and evidence

svg.text: Matrix shows only declared relations. It does not imply transitive authority or unlisted implementation calls.
